title: Database Design Basics
intro: Database design is the fresher-junior data foundation. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with ER diagrams (the modeling starting point), then keys (primary, foreign — the relational glue), then normalization (1NF-2NF-3NF — why we split tables). Transactions and ACID follow as the correctness tier, then the comparison tier — relational vs NoSQL and database comparisons — where a fresher learns when to choose what.
